subtitle: "Figures"
format:
  docx:
    fig-width: 6.5
    fig-cap-location: bottom
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      results = "asis", dpi = 300, out.width = "100%")
source("R_helpers/paper_helpers.R")
# Figure numbers follow the order of first citation in the manuscript.
# File names are those written by the pipeline and are NOT renumbered:
# each chunk states which file it shows.
```

```{r f1, fig.cap="Figure 1. Study area. Bottom-trawl survey strata of the southern Gulf of St Lawrence (sGSL); numbers identify individual strata and the shading gives the depth range of each."}
fig_safe("^Fig1_study_area")          # file Fig1_
```

```{r f2, fig.cap="Figure 2. Prey taxonomic resolution. (A) Number of prey categories retained as the aggregation threshold x (minimum number of stomachs) is swept from 10 to 1,000."}
fig_safe("^Fig3a_")                   # file Fig3a_
```

```{r f2b, fig.cap="Figure 2 (continued). (B) Frequency of the four diagnostic families across the full sweep, by contrast and currency. The values reported in the text are the means of these curves."}
fig_safe("^Fig3b_")                   # file Fig3b_
```

```{r f3, fig.cap="Figure 3. Decision tree of the diagnostic typology. Each eligible predator × size-class cell is routed by the outcomes of the composition, diversity and niche-breadth tests to one of nine states and to its family."}
fig_safe("^Fig4_typology_tree\\.png$") # file Fig4_
```

```{r f4, fig.cap="Figure 4. Gulf-wide diagnostic families. Frequency (%) of the four families among classifiable predator × size-class cells, by contrast and currency; mean and standard deviation across the 100 prey taxonomic resolutions."}
fig_safe("^Fig5_")                    # file Fig5_
```

```{r f5, fig.cap="Figure 5. Spatial distribution of the four diagnostic families across survey strata, biomass currency. Each panel maps the within-stratum family composition for one contrast."}
fig_safe("^Fig9_")                    # file Fig9_
```

```{r f6, fig.cap="Figure 6. Effect of spatial aggregation on the diagnostic composition for the full between-period contrast (2004–2006 vs 2018–2019). Stratum and ecoregion values are means across units; the Gulf-wide value is a single pooled test. Bars are the standard deviation across resolutions."}
fig_safe("^Fig10_")                   # file Fig10_
```
